verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
EBINT(U) ebirungi (e)nnyo
Ebitonde byonna
Byonna ebyewuunyisa
Byatondwa Katonda.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ebimuli ebyaanya
Ye yatinda langi
Obunyonyi-obuyimba
Buyinza-okubuuka.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ebint(u) ebirungi (e)nnyo
Ebitonde byonna
Byonna ebyewuunyisa
Byatondwa Katonda.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ensozi ez'omuddo
Omuli n'emigga,
Enjuba-egwa n'evaayo
-Eggulu litangaala.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Ebint(u) ebirungi (e)nnyo
Ebitonde byonna
Byonna ebyewuunyisa
Byatondwa Katonda.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Empewo eya ttoggo,
-Omusana gw'ekyeya,
Ebibala-ebyengera,
Byonna yabitonda.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Ebint(u) ebirungi (e)nnyo
Ebitonde byonna
Byonna ebyewuunyisa
Byatondwa Katonda.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Ensenyi n'ebibira,
-Ensuku n'ennimiro;
Biyiriro by'emigga
N'ebifo-ebirungi.

verse.name: v9
verse.lines:
Ebint(u) ebirungi (e)nnyo
Ebitonde byonna
Byonna ebyewuunyisa
Byatondwa Katonda.

verse.name: v10
verse.lines:
Tulaba,twewuunya nnyo
Ne tutendereza
Omuyinza wa byonna
Eyatonda bw'atyo.

verse.name: v11
verse.lines:
Ebint(u) ebirungi (e)nnyo
Ebitonde byonna
Byonna ebyewuunyisa
Byatondwa Katonda.
